$comment: The outside tools EmbodyTools offers: tools that are not Embody Games' own, loaded from their own public link with no sign-in. Add an entry and everyone sees the card at their next Blockbench start, with no EmbodyTools release. The team's tools are not listed here: they come from Embody Games' access service, for a signed-in Embody account, and EmbodyTools never loads a link into the Embody-Games GitHub from this list. 'id' must match the id the tool registers, and is what its cache file and its switch are keyed by, so never reuse one for a different tool. 'url' is fetched as it is, with no sign-in. Everything except id, name and url is the card's text, until the tool itself has loaded. No outside tool gets file access ('native') unless Embody Games decides it: npm test refuses one that asks unless scripts/check.mjs lists it in FILE_ACCESS, with its link.

tools.name: Wynncraft Content Tools
tools.author: Crunkle
tools.description: Wynncraft model tools: embed and validate textures, clean up a model for Wynncraft, and set texture drivers, billboard pivots, block and sky brightness and skin shaders. Adds the Wynncraft Actor format.

tools.name: Preview Scene Customiser
tools.author: Ewan Howell
tools.description: Create your own preview scenes, download scenes from the Preview Scene Store, and edit and manage existing ones.

tools.name: GeckoLib Models & Animations
tools.author: Eliot Lash, Tslat, Gecko, McHorse
tools.description: Create animated blocks, items, entities and armour for the GeckoLib mod library for Minecraft: Java Edition, and export their models and animations.

tools.name: Shape Generator
tools.author: dragonmaster95
tools.description: Builds octagons and hexadecagons out of rotated cubes, solid or hollow, at the size, centre and axis you set. Filter > Generate shape, in formats that rotate cubes.

tools.name: Hytale Models
tools.author: JannisX11, Kanno
tools.description: Create models and animations for Hytale: the Hytale character and prop formats, and .blockymodel files opened with their textures.
